svg.title: Freshness Control Plane — system architecture
svg.desc: Aviation sources are ingested into Postgres and Iceberg; Debezium streams Postgres changes through Kafka to a selective re-index consumer that re-embeds only changed chunks into pgvector and updates a freshness registry; an SLA enforcer evaluates freshness contracts; a Claude-based agent checks freshness at query time and labels answers.
svg.text: System architecture · v0.1 · change-driven re-indexing with query-time freshness enforcement
rows write nothing to the WAL
Re-embeds only chunks whose content hash changed
Label computed in code, not by the model
SLO targets: change → index p95 < 60 s · ≥ 90% fewer embeddings than full re-embed · stale-flag recall ≥ 95%
